overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that adding `StaticWebAssetFrameworkPattern` to a ClassLibrary project would automatically mark all .js files as framework assets and materialize them under the `fx/` directory for a consuming Blazor WebAssembly app, without realizing that the pattern also needs to be present in the consuming app's project to trigger the materialization pipeline.
why_it_breaks: The test only adds the `StaticWebAssetFrameworkPattern` to the ClassLibrary project. The materialization of framework assets from P2P references requires the consuming app to also declare the same pattern (or the framework assets must be explicitly listed). Without the pattern in the consumer, the tasks that copy `.js` files to the `fx/` directory and generate the `_framework/blazor.webassembly.<fingerprint>.js` manifest never activate, so the file is never produced and the browser returns 404.
